title: Frank J. Martucci
summary: Frank J. Martcucci is an Italian writer who wrote the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers book releases, The Amulet Seekers and The City of Atlantis, and the unpublished books The Blood Spiral and The Showdown.
full_text: Frank J. Martcucci is an Italian writer who wrote the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers book releases, The Amulet Seekers and The City of Atlantis, and the unpublished books The Blood Spiral and The Showdown.
raw_wikitext:
'''Frank J. Martcucci''' is an Italian writer who wrote the ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'' book releases, ''[[The Amulet Seekers]]'' and ''[[The City of Atlantis]]'', and the unpublished books ''[[The Blood Spiral (book)|The Blood Spiral]]'' and ''[[The Showdown]]''. ''
